Preserve transparent green uniaxial tourmaline, rectangular cut and normal incidence, one-plate rotation invariant intensity, two parallel plates with same axes transmitting dimmer light, fixed first/rotated second gradual reduction and crossed extinction. Separate plate planes from in-plane axis directions and explain why a purely longitudinal model cannot distinguish transverse analyzer directions.

Retain natural/unpolarized transverse directions and rotational symmetry, with statistically varying directions rather than every direction simultaneously in one coherent field. Keep source water comparison as a simplified mechanical example, not a general exact water-motion law.

Preserve crystal-selected plane p, plane/linear polarization, 90-degree crossed case and noncrossed amplitude projection. Explain a component/projection without confusing amplitude with intensity or presenting ideal extinction as every real device being perfect.

Preserve rubber-rope transverse changing-direction analogy, first narrow wooden box selection, second identical box rotated 90 degrees blocking the selected direction. Distinguish constrained rope displacement from actual light and do not say real energy is destroyed.

Preserve historical polarizer composition, 0.1 mm thickness, celluloid/glass support, large-area benefit, literal violet-to-white source claim with clear historical attribution rather than a valid general wavelength conversion, and historical headlights/windshield 45-degree proposal including opposing rejection, own reflected-road return, and all-cars condition. Do not turn this into a current vehicle modification or safety recommendation.
